title: Two Plays For Puritans by George Bernard Shaw 1979 Easton Press Genuine Leather
descriptionText:
This luxury edition of "Two Plays For Puritans" by George Bernard Shaw is a collector's item that any classic book lover would be proud to own. The genuine leather binding, illustrated with beautiful imagery, makes this book a work of art in and of itself. 

Written in English, this book contains special attributes that make it a unique addition to any collection. The publisher, Easton Press, is well-known for its high-quality books and this one is no exception. With its character family featuring Sherlock Holmes, this book is a must-have for any fan of the classic detective.
